These posts are written *entirely* by myself.
After I finish my drafts, I use Grammarly to check for grammatical mistakes,
and if I think more sophisticated guidance is needed,
I ask some LLM for any remaining doubts.
Otherwise, I do not use any LLM-generated sentences,
even if my own sound cringe in an LLM's *"opinion"*,
as I intend to use *my own voice* without any alterations.
